pr_title: Return to the same place when triggering a DAG
pr_body:
Rather than always going to the DAG's default view, return to the same view as you were on.

closes: #20197

issue_context.title: Triggering a DAG in Graph view switches to Tree view
issue_context.body:
### Apache Airflow version

2.2.2 (latest released)

### What happened

After I trigger a DAG from the Graph view, the view switches to the Tree view (happens on both 2.2.2 and main).

### What you expected to happen

I expect to stay in the Graph view, ideally switch to the newly created DAG run

### How to reproduce

Trigger a DAG from the Graph view
